tools.title: Compress PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Shrink a PDF and see exactly what it cost: size before and after, pages kept, text still selectable. A file that grows is refused.
tools.lede: Ghostscript presets, run in a sandbox, on a file you upload. The difference is what comes back with it: a measurement of what the compression actually did to your document.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.help: Balanced is the default and suits reading on screen and printing at home. Smallest file downsamples images hardest; prepress keeps the most detail.

params.name: dpi
params.label: Image resolution (dpi)
params.help: Optional, 36 to 1200. Overrides the resolution carried by the level above. Leave empty to keep the preset.

steps: Drop the PDF you want to make lighter.
Pick a level. Balanced is right for almost every document that will be read on screen.
Run the compression, read the verdict, download the file — or chain another tool on it without uploading again.
tools.verdict_says: It measures the same three things before and after: pages, characters of selectable text, and bytes. You get the reduction rate, and a failure — not a smaller file — if the compression rasterised the pages and cost you a searchable document. And if the compressed file comes out larger than the original, you get the original back, with the verdict saying the document was already optimised.

faq.q: Will the text still be selectable and searchable?
faq.a: The verdict answers that for your specific file, by counting the extractable characters before and after. Above 98 % kept it reports the text as intact; below 50 % it reports a failure, because the compression rasterised the pages. Nobody has to open the file to find out.

faq.q: What if my PDF is already compressed?
faq.a: Ghostscript still runs, but the result is compared to the source. If the attempt is bigger than the original, the original is what you receive, and the verdict says so in as many words. You never get a heavier file back under the name of a compression.
They are erased 2 hours after upload, automatically. You can also delete them straight away from the result panel. No model is trained on them and nobody reads them.
100 MB and 2000 pages per file. Beyond that the upload is refused with the reason, rather than failing halfway through the work.

tools.title: Merge PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Join several PDFs into one, in the order you set. A file that is not a readable PDF is named and refused before anything is joined.
tools.lede: Drop two files or twenty; they are joined in the order they appear in the list. Nothing is re-encoded, so every page arrives exactly as it left.
steps: Drop at least two PDFs. The order of the list is the order of the merged document.
Run the merge.
Download the joined file, or delete everything from our servers straight away.
tools.verdict_says: Joining pages cannot damage them, so this tool answers with the document rather than a verdict card. What it does check is the input: a file whose bytes are not a PDF is refused by name and by type — "this endpoint needs a PDF" — before a single page is joined. You never receive a merged document quietly missing one of its sources.

faq.q: How many files can I merge at once?
faq.a: Two at minimum, twenty in one go from this page. Each of them may weigh up to 100 MB and hold up to 2000 pages.

faq.q: Is the quality of the pages affected?
faq.a: No. The pages are copied, not re-rendered: fonts, images and the text layer arrive untouched, and the merged file is the sum of its sources.

faq.q: In what order are the files joined?
faq.a: The order they appear in the list under the drop zone. Remove a file and add it again to move it to the end.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately if you use the delete button on the result. No model training, no human reading, sovereign hosting.

tools.meta_description: Cut one PDF into several files, every N pages or at the cut points you name. Each part comes back separately, ready to download.
tools.lede: One document in, several out. Either a fixed number of pages per file, or the exact points where the cut should fall.

params.name: every
params.label: Pages per file
params.help: One file per page by default. Ignored when cut points are given below.

params.name: pages
params.label: Cut points
params.help: Optional. The pages a new file starts at. "4,9" on a 12-page document gives 1-3, 4-8 and 9-12.

steps: Drop the document to cut.
Give a number of pages per file, or the cut points if the parts are uneven.
Run it: every part comes back as its own file, each with its page count.
tools.verdict_says: Cutting a document cannot alter a page, so this tool answers with the parts and their page counts rather than a verdict card. The range is checked against the real page count first: a cut point the document does not have is refused with your range quoted back, instead of a file that silently comes up a page short. At most 500 parts in one call.

faq.q: How do I get one file per chapter?
faq.a: Leave the pages-per-file field empty and write the cut points: the first page of each chapter, separated by commas. Each part then runs from one cut point to the page before the next.

faq.q: Can I download all the parts at once?
faq.a: Yes. The result panel lists every part with its own download button, plus a button that downloads them all.
The document you upload and every part produced are erased after 2 hours, and can be deleted immediately from the result panel.

tools.title: Extract pages online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Keep only the pages you name — 1,3,5-9, odd, even — in one new document. Ranges are checked against the real page count.
tools.lede: Name the pages you want to keep; everything else is left behind. The pages come out in document order, whatever order you wrote them in.

params.name: pages
params.label: Pages to keep
params.help: Commas and ranges: "1,3,5-9". "2-" means page 2 to the end. "all", "odd" and "even" are understood too.

steps: Drop the document.
Write the pages to keep, as a list, ranges, or odd/even.
Run it, and download a document holding only those pages.
tools.verdict_says: This is a lossless selection, so the answer is the document and its page count rather than a verdict card. The safety net is in the reading of your range: a page number the document does not have, an inverted range, or a range that selects nothing at all are all refused — with the offending text quoted back — rather than returned as a document missing a page you thought you had.

faq.q: How do I write the range?
faq.a: "1,3,5-9" keeps pages 1, 3 and 5 through 9. "2-" keeps page 2 to the end. "odd" and "even" keep every other page, and "all" keeps everything.

faq.q: Do the pages come out in the order I wrote them?
faq.a: No, extraction sorts them into document order and drops duplicates. To set a new order, use the reorder tool, which reads your list as the order itself.
No. The pages are copied as they are: text layer, fonts, images and bookmarks on the kept pages arrive untouched.

faq.q: Do I have to list every page?

faq.q: How do I move the last page to the front on a 10-page document?
faq.a: Write "10,1-9". Ranges and single pages can be mixed freely.
No. The pages are copied in the order you gave: nothing is re-rendered or re-encoded.

tools.meta_description: Turn every page, or only the ones you name, by a quarter turn. Anything that is not a quarter turn is refused before the file is touched.
tools.lede: A scan that came in sideways is turned in one call, on the whole document or on the pages that need it.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle (degrees)
params.help: A quarter turn, clockwise: 90, 180 or 270. Write -90, -180 or -270 to turn the other way. Anything else is refused before the file is opened.

params.name: pages
params.label: Pages
params.help: Empty means every page. Otherwise "1,3,5-9", "2-", "odd" or "even".

steps: Drop the document.
Choose the angle, and the pages if only some of them are the wrong way round.
Run it, and download the turned document.
tools.verdict_says: Rotation writes an attribute on the page rather than rebuilding it, so the answer is the document itself and not a verdict card. The refusals are strict on purpose: an angle that is not 90, 180, 270 or one of their negatives is rejected before the file is opened, and a page range outside the document is rejected with the range quoted back.

faq.a: No. Rotation sets the page's rotation attribute; the text layer, the fonts and the images are the ones from your file, at their original quality.

faq.q: Can I turn just one page?
faq.a: Yes. Write its number in the pages field. Everything left out keeps its current orientation.
Because that is what a PDF page can record. Any other angle would mean re-rendering the page as an image, and losing a searchable document to fix an orientation is a bad trade.

tools.title: Crop PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Trim the margins of a PDF automatically, or to an exact box in points. The verdict names the pages that could not be measured.
tools.lede: Automatic mode measures where the text actually sits on each page and cuts to it, with a margin. Or give the box yourself, in PostScript points.

params.name: box
params.label: Crop box
params.help: "auto" measures the content of each page. Otherwise four numbers in points, left to top: [50, 50, 545, 790].

params.name: margin
params.label: Margin kept (pt)
params.help: Automatic mode only. The white space left around the measured content, 0 to 500 points. 28 pt is about a centimetre.

params.name: pages
params.label: Pages
params.help: Empty means every page. Pages left out keep their box untouched.

steps: Drop the document with margins to trim.
Leave the box on "auto" and adjust the margin, or write the four coordinates yourself.
Run it, read which pages were actually cropped, and download.
tools.verdict_says: The verdict says how many pages of how many were really cropped, and names the pages whose content could not be measured — a blank or fully graphic page keeps its original box rather than being cropped to nothing. A box you gave that reached past the edge of the page is clamped to the page and reported, and if nothing could be cropped the source is handed back unchanged with that said plainly.

faq.q: How does automatic mode know where to cut?
faq.a: It reads the position of every word on the page and takes the smallest rectangle containing them, plus your margin. That is a measurement of the actual text, not a guess from the page size.

faq.q: What happens to a page with no text?
faq.a: It keeps its original box, and the verdict names it. Cropping a page whose content cannot be measured would produce a blank page, which is worse than not cropping.

faq.q: Is the content lost or just hidden?
faq.a: Cropping changes the visible box of the page; the underlying objects are still in the file. If the point is to remove information for good, use the redaction tool, which destroys it.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel.

tools.title: Add page numbers online, free | AI SmartTalk
tools.h1: Add page numbers to a PDF
tools.meta_description: Number the pages of an existing PDF, in the position and format you choose, without touching its text layer.
tools.lede: A numbering layer is rendered and laid over your document. The pages underneath are not rebuilt, so the text stays selectable.

params.name: format
params.label: Format
params.help: Plain text with two tokens: {page} and {pages}. For example "Page {page} of {pages}". No HTML.

params.name: start
params.label: First number
params.help: The number printed on the first numbered page, when the document continues another one.

params.name: from_page
params.label: Start numbering at page
params.help: Pages before this one get no number — a cover page, for instance.

params.name: font_size
params.label: Font size (pt)
params.help: Between 4 and 72.

params.name: margin
params.label: Margin
params.help: Distance from the edge of the page. Units: pt, mm, cm, in, px.

steps: Drop the document to number.
Choose the format, the position, and the page numbering should start on.
Run it, check the verdict, and download.
tools.verdict_says: The verdict checks the one thing an overlay can silently break: the page count. A document that comes out with a different number of pages than it went in is reported as a failure, not as a numbered file. It also reports whether the numbering layer has exactly one page per source page, names the pages whose size differs from page one — the layer follows page one and is scaled to fit the others — and says how many pages were numbered, from which page, starting at which number.

faq.q: Does it damage the existing text?
faq.a: No. The numbers are a separate layer laid over your pages; the text underneath keeps its fonts and stays selectable and searchable.

faq.q: Can I skip the cover page?
faq.a: Yes. Set "start numbering at page" to 2. If you also want the second page to read 1, set the first number to 1 — the two settings are independent.

faq.q: What if my pages are not all the same size?
faq.a: The numbering layer is built for the size of page one and scaled onto the others. The verdict names how many pages have another size, so you can check the result on those.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel.

tools.label: Add page numbers

tools.title: Watermark PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Lay a diagonal text watermark over every page of a PDF, with the opacity and angle you choose. The text layer stays untouched.
tools.lede: "Draft", "Confidential", a client name: the text is rendered as a layer and laid over the document, which is left exactly as it was underneath.

params.name: opacity
params.label: Opacity
params.help: Between 0 and 1. The default, 0.06, stays readable without getting in the way of the text.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle (degrees)
params.help: Between -360 and 360. -45 is the usual diagonal.

steps: Drop the document to mark.
Write the text, and adjust the opacity and angle if the default is not right.
Run it and download the marked document.
tools.verdict_says: The watermark is a layer laid over your pages, not a re-render of them: the text underneath keeps its fonts and stays selectable and searchable, which the tools that flatten a document to stamp it cannot say. Opacity and angle are checked against their bounds before anything is rendered, so a value out of range comes back as a clear refusal rather than an invisible mark. This endpoint predates our verdict card and answers with the file itself.

faq.q: Does the watermark make the text unselectable?
faq.a: No. The pages are not rasterised: the watermark sits above them as its own layer, and your text layer is the original one.
A watermark is a visual mark, not a protection — anyone with the right tool can lift a layer. To make information genuinely disappear, use the redaction tool, which rebuilds the pages from pixels.

faq.q: Do you add a watermark of your own?
faq.a: Never, on any tool, on any plan. The only mark on your file is the one you asked for.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel.

tools.title: Protect PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 and a password of your choosing. The password is never stored and never appears in a process list.
tools.lede: The document is encrypted by qpdf with 256-bit AES. Without the password it cannot be opened, by us or by anyone else.

params.name: password
params.label: Password
params.help: Becomes both the opening password and the permissions password. It is used once and kept nowhere — write it down before you run the tool.

steps: Drop the document to protect.
Type the password. Keep it somewhere safe: nothing here can recover it.
Run it and download the encrypted document.
tools.verdict_says: The encryption is AES-256, and the password is handled the way a password should be: qpdf reads it from a temporary argument file rather than the command line, so it never shows up in the process list of the machine, and it is written to no log and no database. A password containing a line break is refused, because it could otherwise smuggle in an extra option. This endpoint predates our verdict card and answers with the file itself.

faq.q: Can you recover my password if I lose it?
faq.a: No. It is used for the single call and kept nowhere. A lost password means a document nobody can open, which is exactly what the encryption is for.
256-bit AES, the strongest level the PDF format defines. Your password becomes both the user password and the owner password.

faq.q: Does the file still work everywhere?
faq.a: Yes. Any current PDF reader asks for the password and opens the document; nothing beyond the encryption is changed.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel. The password is never part of what is stored.

tools.title: Unlock PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Remove the password from a PDF you already have the password for. No password is ever guessed, searched for or broken here.
tools.lede: For a document you can open but that asks for its password every time. You supply the password; the encryption is removed.

params.name: password
params.label: Current password
params.help: The password that opens the document today. Required: this tool removes a protection you already hold, it never recovers one.

steps: Drop the protected document.
Type the password that opens it.
Run it, and download a document that opens without one.
tools.verdict_says: The verdict confirms, on the produced file, that its pages are no longer password protected, and passes on anything qpdf remarked — including the case where the file was not encrypted at all and the password was simply ignored. A password that does not open the document comes back as a plain refusal saying so, not as a tool failure. And no password is ever guessed here: an empty password is refused, because this endpoint removes a protection you hold, it does not break one.

faq.q: Can you open a document whose password I do not have?
faq.a: No, and that is a design decision, not a limitation. No password is searched for, guessed or broken. Without the password the request is refused.

faq.q: What if the document was not actually encrypted?
faq.a: You get the document back and the verdict says the file was not encrypted and the password was ignored, rather than pretending work was done.
No. It travels to qpdf through a temporary argument file, appears in no process list, and is written to no log.

tools.title: Repair PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Rebuild a PDF that no longer opens. The verdict says which method worked and how many pages were actually recovered.
tools.lede: Two attempts, in order: rebuild the file's internal tables, and if that fails, rewrite the document entirely. The difference matters, so it is reported.
steps: Drop the file that will not open.
Run the repair.
Read the verdict — how many pages came back, and by which method — then download.
tools.verdict_says: The verdict names the method, because the two are not equivalent. Rebuilt by qpdf means the cross-reference tables were repaired and the objects are still your original ones. Rewritten by Ghostscript means qpdf could not read the file at all, and it comes back as a warning: annotations, form fields and attachments may not have survived. It also compares the page count with the damaged file's, when that file still reported one, and says how many pages were recovered.

faq.q: Can every damaged PDF be repaired?
faq.a: No. If neither method can read a single page, the request fails and says so, rather than handing back an empty file that looks like a result.

faq.q: What is the difference between the two methods?
faq.a: The first repairs the file's index and keeps your objects untouched. The second rebuilds the document from what can still be rendered — the pages come back, but what is not page content may not.

faq.q: Will I get all my pages back?
faq.a: The verdict answers for your file: it compares the recovered page count with the one the damaged file declared, and warns when pages are missing.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel.

tools.label: Repair PDF

tools.title: OCR PDF online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.meta_description: Add a searchable text layer to a scanned PDF. The verdict names, page by page, every page that came back unreadable.
tools.lede: A scan becomes a document you can search, select and copy from. And you are told which pages the recognition struggled with, instead of finding out later.

params.name: languages
params.label: Languages
params.help: Comma separated, in order of likelihood. Installed: eng, fra, deu, spa, ita.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.help: Automatic leaves pages that already carry a text layer alone. Force rasterises and reads everything again.

params.name: pdfa
params.label: Produce a PDF/A archive file
params.help: Adds the archival identification in the same pass.

steps: Drop the scanned document.
Pick the languages it is written in, and a mode if the default does not fit.
Run it, read which pages came back weak, and download a searchable document.
tools.verdict_says: The verdict says how many pages were read, how many already carried a text layer and were left alone, and then it names — one by one, with their page number and their character count — the pages where fewer than fifty characters were recognised: a blank page, a photograph, or a scan too degraded to read. Every remark from the recognition engine is passed on rather than swallowed. An OCR that hands back a file without mentioning the two pages that came out empty is an OCR that lies.

faq.a: English, French, German, Spanish and Italian, and they can be combined: a document mixing two languages is read with both dictionaries loaded.
300 pages per call, on top of the general limits of 100 MB and 2000 pages per uploaded file. Recognition is the most expensive operation here, and the ceiling is what keeps it available to everyone.

faq.q: Will the pages look different afterwards?
faq.a: In automatic mode, pages that already have text are not touched at all. Pages that are read get an invisible text layer laid under the image — what you see stays the scan you sent.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel. No model is trained on your documents and nobody reads them.

tools.title: PDF to Word online, free and watermark-free | AI SmartTalk
tools.h1: PDF to Word, Excel or PowerPoint
tools.meta_description: Turn a PDF into an editable document, and get a measurement of how much of the text was actually recovered.
tools.lede: A PDF holds glyphs at coordinates, not paragraphs and tables — those have to be guessed. This tool says so, and then measures how well the guess went.
steps: Drop the PDF to convert.
Choose the target format.
Read the verdict before you reuse the file, then download it.
tools.verdict_says: The produced document is rendered back to PDF and read again, because the only honest way to say what a reconstruction kept is to measure it. The verdict compares the characters recovered against the characters in your original — intact above 98 %, a warning with the exact percentage below that, a failure below half, meaning this PDF does not lend itself to being made editable. It also reports the repagination, and if the produced file cannot be re-read it says the fidelity was not verified rather than staying silent.

faq.q: Will the result look exactly like my PDF?
faq.a: No, and no tool can promise that. A PDF does not record paragraphs, tables or styles: they are inferred from where the characters sit. Read the file before you send it on — the verdict tells you how much of the text was recovered.
A scan has no text layer, so there is nothing to reconstruct and the verdict says so plainly. Run the OCR tool first, then convert the result.

faq.q: Which formats can I convert to?
faq.a: Word (docx), Excel (xlsx) and PowerPoint (pptx). Pick the one matching the nature of the document: a spreadsheet reconstructed into Word is a poor result whatever the tool.
Erased after 2 hours, or immediately from the result panel.

params.label: Resolution (dpi)
params.help: Between 36 and 300. 150 is comfortable on screen; 300 is print resolution and four times the weight.

params.label: Pages

Choose the format, the resolution, and the pages if you do not want all of them.

tools.verdict_says: The verdict opens the produced file and looks for the PDF/A identification inside it: if the converter gave up and wrote an ordinary PDF under an archival name, that is reported as a failure, which is the one conformance error detectable without a validator. faq.a: No, and we say so rather than implying otherwise. This service produces PDF/A and verifies the identification is present, but runs no validator. For a deposit that demands proof, have the file checked by a validator such as veraPDF.
PDF/A-2B unless your archive names another. PDF/A-1B is the strictest and refuses transparency; PDF/A-3B is the only one that lets you keep attached files.
Level A requires a tagged reading order for accessibility. It cannot be invented from an untagged document, and declaring a level we cannot produce would be worse than refusing it.
